title: Inspect Git-unreported metadata and unsupported entries in pinned child checkouts
outcome: Pinned-child admission explicitly inspects Git-unreported non-repository .git entries and unsupported filesystem types within the existing shared budget, or an independently approved contract revision defines their treatment.
acceptance: Native fixtures cover invalid .git metadata beneath otherwise unreported directories and applicable FIFO/socket/device entries, including excluded subtrees, without relying on Git status to enumerate them.
The chosen behavior is reviewed against the canonical source-identity contract and preserves the existing capture deadline, path budget, ordinary-root behavior, and read-only boundary.
